modules.name: Button
modules.description: Actions with consistent hierarchy, sizing, loading, and accessible icon treatment.

modules.name: Button Group
modules.description: An attached cluster of related actions with hairline seams and shared corner radius.

modules.name: Segmented Control
modules.description: A mutually exclusive option switcher with a sliding selection pill.

modules.name: Link
modules.description: Themed inline and standalone links with an external indicator.

modules.name: Toggle
modules.description: A pressed-state button for binary preferences in toolbars and filter rows.

modules.name: Toolbar
modules.description: A horizontal action bar with grouped controls and hairline separators.

modules.name: Split Button
modules.description: A primary action joined to a menu of related alternatives.

modules.name: Action Bar
modules.description: A horizontal bar for contextual page-level actions such as a sticky save/cancel bar at the bottom of an editing surface.

modules.name: Bulk Action Bar
modules.description: A bar that appears when list or table rows are selected, announcing the selection count and offering bulk actions.

modules.name: Floating Action Button
modules.description: A fixed-position primary action button for the single most important creation task on a screen.

modules.name: Share Button
modules.description: A button that opens a small popover with a copy-link action and, where supported, the native share sheet.

modules.name: Speed Dial
modules.description: A floating button that expands into a fan of related creation actions with full keyboard support.

modules.name: Field
modules.description: A deep form seam that connects labels, descriptions, errors, and required state.

modules.name: Input and TextArea
modules.description: Native text controls with Teal sizing, invalid states, and forwarded refs.

modules.name: Select
modules.description: An accessible single-value picker with keyboard navigation, typeahead, and collision-aware positioning.

modules.name: Checkbox
modules.description: Boolean and indeterminate selection with an integrated label and description.

modules.name: Switch
modules.description: An immediate boolean setting with explicit labeling and controlled or uncontrolled state.

modules.name: Radio Group
modules.description: A single-choice option set with an integrated label, description, and subtle borders.

modules.name: Slider
modules.description: A numeric value scrubber with an optional live value readout.

modules.name: Search Input
modules.description: A text field with a leading search affordance, clear action, and loading state.

modules.name: Combobox
modules.description: A filterable single-value picker combining free text with a suggestion list.

modules.name: Multi Select
modules.description: A filterable picker for several values, shown as removable pills.

modules.name: Date Picker
modules.description: A single-date field with a keyboard-navigable calendar popover.

modules.name: Number Input
modules.description: A numeric field with stepper buttons and min/max clamping.

modules.name: Password Input
modules.description: A secret field with an accessible visibility toggle.

modules.name: File Upload
modules.description: A drag-and-drop zone with a browse action and a removable file list.

modules.name: PIN Input
modules.description: A segmented one-time code field with per-cell navigation, paste support, and masking.

modules.name: Tags Input
modules.description: A token entry field that turns typed text into removable chips.

modules.name: Input Group
modules.description: An input joined with leading or trailing addons such as protocols and units.

modules.name: Editable
modules.description: Click-to-edit text that commits on Enter or blur and cancels with Escape.

modules.name: Time Picker
modules.description: A segmented hour and minute field with 12- and 24-hour cycles.

modules.name: Date Range Picker
modules.description: A two-click range field with presets and a keyboard-navigable calendar popover.

modules.name: Color Picker
modules.description: A swatch trigger with preset colors and a validated hex field.

modules.name: Autosize Textarea
modules.description: A textarea that grows and shrinks with its content, capped by a maximum row count.

modules.name: Cascader
modules.description: A multi-level option picker that walks a hierarchy column by column and commits the full path of values.

modules.name: Checkbox Card
modules.description: A checkbox rendered as a selectable card with a title, description, and optional icon; works standalone or stacked in groups.

modules.name: Currency Input
modules.description: A numeric amount field with a leading currency symbol that formats the value with Intl.NumberFormat on blur.

modules.name: Date Time Picker
modules.description: A single popover that pairs a calendar grid with time fields and emits one Date.

modules.name: Fieldset
modules.description: A semantic fieldset/legend group for related fields, with optional help text linked to the whole group.

modules.name: Form
modules.description: A lightweight form wrapper that collects field values on submit and shares an error map through context, with no form library.

modules.name: Form Error Summary
modules.description: A top-of-form alert that lists validation errors as anchor links which focus the offending field.

modules.name: Masked Input
modules.description: A text field that enforces a simple digit mask, inserting separators automatically as the user types.

modules.name: Mention Input
modules.description: A textarea with @-mention autocomplete that inserts chosen people as plain text tokens.

modules.name: Month Picker
modules.description: A popover grid of the twelve months with a year stepper for fast month-and-year selection.

modules.name: Password Strength Meter
modules.description: A progressbar-style meter that visualizes password strength from a caller-supplied or built-in score.

modules.name: Phone Input
modules.description: A country calling-code dropdown paired with a national number field that emits an E.164-ish string.

modules.name: Radio Card
modules.description: A radio group rendered as selectable cards with a title, description, and optional icon, for choices that need explanation.

modules.name: Range Slider
modules.description: A dual-thumb slider for choosing a low/high pair, with per-thumb labels and an optional value readout.

modules.name: Rich Text Editor
modules.description: A lightweight markdown editor whose toolbar formats the textarea selection, with an optional live preview pane.

modules.name: Timezone Select
modules.description: A searchable select over a curated set of IANA timezones with UTC offset labels.

modules.name: Toggle Group
modules.description: A cluster of Toggle-styled options with roving focus, in mutually exclusive single mode or independent multiple mode.

modules.name: Transfer List
modules.description: A dual listbox that moves options between an available list and a chosen list with buttons or the keyboard.

modules.name: Tree Select
modules.description: A single-select control whose popover shows an expandable, typeahead-enabled tree of options.

modules.name: Year Picker
modules.description: A popover grid of years with decade paging for fast year-only selection.

modules.name: Card
modules.description: A structural surface for related content without ambiguous interactive behavior.

modules.name: Launcher Card
modules.description: An interactive application destination card with an icon, description, optional status, and an honest unavailable state.

modules.name: Badge
modules.description: A compact semantic status indicator using canonical information variants.

modules.name: Accordion
modules.description: A stacked disclosure list with single and multi-open modes driven by a compact item interface.

modules.name: Chip
modules.description: A compact filter or selection token with an optional remove affordance.

modules.name: Kbd
modules.description: An inline keyboard shortcut hint with a raised keycap treatment.

modules.name: Scroll Area
modules.description: A scrollable region with styled, theme-consistent scrollbars.

modules.name: Code Block
modules.description: A code panel with a language label, optional line numbers, and copy-to-clipboard.

modules.name: Callout
modules.description: A quiet admonition surface with a variant icon and accent border, for guidance that informs without interrupting.

modules.name: Expandable Card
modules.description: A card that expands and collapses its extra content with a built-in trigger, chevron affordance, and smooth height animation.

modules.name: Glass Panel
modules.description: A frosted-glass surface with backdrop blur and a translucent background, for content floating over imagery or color.

modules.name: Panel
modules.description: A lightweight bordered surface with optional header and actions, for grouping content without Card's elevation.

modules.name: Dialog
modules.description: A modal surface that owns focus management, naming, dismissal, and scroll locking.

modules.name: Tooltip
modules.description: A short contextual hint with accessible trigger association and collision handling.

modules.name: Menu
modules.description: A structured action menu with keyboard navigation, disabled items, icons, and danger styling.

modules.name: Popover
modules.description: An anchored surface for arbitrary controls and supplemental content.

modules.name: Drawer
modules.description: A slide-over panel for focused side tasks, built on the dialog focus model.

modules.name: Hover Card
modules.description: A rich preview surface revealed on hover or focus, for context without navigation.

modules.name: Command
modules.description: A command palette dialog with grouped, filterable actions and keyboard navigation.

modules.name: Alert Dialog
modules.description: A blocking confirmation that holds focus until an explicit choice is made.

modules.name: Popconfirm
modules.description: A lightweight anchored confirmation for small destructive or irreversible actions.

modules.name: Context Menu
modules.description: A right-click action menu attached to any element, sharing the Menu item contract.

modules.name: Tour
modules.description: A guided walkthrough that highlights target elements step by step.

modules.name: Action Sheet
modules.description: An iOS-style bottom sheet listing actions with a destructive option and a separated cancel button.

modules.name: Bottom Sheet
modules.description: A sheet that slides up from the bottom edge with snap heights, ideal for mobile-first flows.

modules.name: Cookie Consent
modules.description: Polite, non-modal bottom banner for cookie consent with accept and decline actions and an optional preferences link.

modules.name: Floating Panel
modules.description: A non-modal panel anchored to a viewport corner for tools that coexist with the page.

modules.name: Fullscreen Dialog
modules.description: A dialog that occupies the entire viewport with a header close button for immersive tasks.

modules.name: Image Viewer
modules.description: Inline viewer for a single image with toolbar and keyboard zoom plus pointer-drag panning while zoomed.

modules.name: Lightbox
modules.description: Full-screen gallery overlay for paging through images with arrow keys, on-screen controls, and a live counter.

modules.name: Notification Center
modules.description: Popover panel that lists recent notifications with read states and a mark-all-read action.

modules.name: Prompt Dialog
modules.description: A modal dialog with a single labeled input that returns the entered value on confirm.

modules.name: Search Overlay
modules.description: Full-screen search overlay with a large input and caller-rendered results navigated entirely from the keyboard.

modules.name: Toast
modules.description: Imperative, announced feedback with semantic variants, optional actions, and dismissal.

modules.name: Empty State
modules.description: An explanatory empty result with an optional action and SVG icon.

modules.name: Loading
modules.description: Named progress and loading treatments for local, skeleton, and full-surface states.

modules.name: Alert
modules.description: An inline feedback banner with semantic variants, an optional title, and dismissal.

modules.name: Notification Item
modules.description: A sanitized ecosystem inbox row with severity, source application, read state, deep link, and delivery-state controls.

modules.name: Health Indicator
modules.description: An explicit ecosystem health status that reports unknown and stale evidence instead of implying health.

modules.name: Step-Up Notice
modules.description: An inline warning that explains a required fresh verification and hosts the caller’s verification action.

modules.name: Banner
modules.description: A page-level notice strip for workspace-wide feedback that owns the top of a view.

modules.name: Progress Circle
modules.description: A radial progress indicator with determinate and indeterminate modes.

modules.name: Timeline
modules.description: A vertical activity feed with tone dots, connectors, and timestamps.

modules.name: Meter
modules.description: A scalar gauge for a known range with optimum-zone coloring.

modules.name: Rating
modules.description: A star rating input with radio semantics, arrow keys, and a read-only display mode.

modules.name: Announcer
modules.description: A visually hidden live region that re-announces a message whenever it changes.

modules.name: Blocking Overlay
modules.description: A full-surface overlay with a spinner that blocks interaction with the wrapped content during async work.

modules.name: Error Boundary
modules.description: A class-based error boundary that isolates render failures behind a fallback UI with reset support.

modules.name: Loading Bar
modules.description: A thin top-of-page progress bar with determinate and indeterminate modes.

modules.name: Network Status
modules.description: An inline indicator of the browser's online/offline state with a render prop for custom display.

modules.name: Offline Banner
modules.description: A dismissible banner that appears at the top of the page when the browser loses connectivity.

modules.name: Pulse Dot
modules.description: An animated pulsing dot that signals live presence or ongoing activity.

modules.name: Save Status
modules.description: An inline saved/saving/error indicator with an optional relative timestamp.

modules.name: Status Dot
modules.description: A small colored dot with an optional text label for compact entity status.

modules.name: Upload Progress
modules.description: A file upload progress row with file name, determinate bar, formatted size, and a cancel button.

modules.name: App Switcher
modules.description: An entitlement-filtered application switcher with an explicit Home destination and keyboard navigation.

modules.name: Account Menu
modules.description: A household account menu with an identity header, product items, and distinct app and SSO sign-out actions.

modules.name: Tabs
modules.description: Keyboard-navigable content switching through a compact item interface.

modules.name: Pagination
modules.description: A controlled page navigator with compact ranges and unavailable directions.

modules.name: Page Header
modules.description: A responsive page title, supporting text, and action area.

modules.name: Vertical Nav
modules.description: A compound vertical navigation with icon-rail and full-text modes.

modules.name: Nav Rail
modules.description: A fully rounded floating icon rail for dense product navigation.

modules.name: Side Rail
modules.description: A floating glass rail that expands from an icon strip to a full label list on hover or focus.

modules.name: Ecosystem Rail
modules.description: A persistent cross-product rail with a stable Home destination, caller-filtered applications, and honest health status.

modules.name: Top Bar
modules.description: A sticky top bar with brand, search, and action slots.

modules.name: Breadcrumb
modules.description: A hierarchical trail with router-ready items and automatic middle-item collapse.

modules.name: Steps
modules.description: A numbered flow indicator with done, current, and upcoming states.

modules.name: Tree View
modules.description: A hierarchical disclosure list with keyboard navigation and selection.

modules.name: Menubar
modules.description: An application command bar of labeled dropdown menus with full keyboard navigation.

modules.name: Navigation Menu
modules.description: A top-level navigation bar mixing links with rich content panels in a shared viewport.

modules.name: Back Top
modules.description: A floating button that appears after scrolling and returns to the top of the page.

modules.name: Anchor Nav
modules.description: A scroll-spy nav of page section anchors that highlights the section in view and smooth-scrolls on click.

modules.name: Bottom Nav
modules.description: A mobile bottom navigation bar of three to five icon-and-label items with aria-current and safe-area padding.

modules.name: Dock
modules.description: A macOS-style dock of icon buttons with hover tooltips, accessible names, and an active-app indicator dot.

modules.name: Floating Toolbar
modules.description: A floating contextual toolbar that appears near a selection or anchored element, with roving tabindex and arrow-key navigation.

modules.name: Mega Menu
modules.description: A top-level navigation item that opens a multi-column link panel on hover, focus, or click, with full keyboard support.

modules.name: Sidebar
modules.description: A full app sidebar with header, content, and footer slots that collapses to an icon rail, with aria-current on the active item.

modules.name: Skip Link
modules.description: A visually-hidden-until-focused "Skip to content" link that becomes the first tab stop of the page.

modules.name: Sub Nav
modules.description: A secondary horizontal nav row with an underline indicator for the active item that scrolls when items overflow.

modules.name: Table of Contents
modules.description: A nested list of heading links that indents by heading level and highlights the section in view with an IntersectionObserver.

modules.name: Permission Matrix
modules.description: A people-by-applications access matrix with caller-supplied cell content and explicit no-access cells.

modules.name: Table
modules.description: Accessible data presentation driven by column definitions, density, loading, and empty state.

modules.name: Separator
modules.description: A semantic or decorative divider for related content.

modules.name: Avatar
modules.description: A compact identity image with initials and icon fallbacks.

modules.name: Description List
modules.description: A label/value definition list for detail pages, stacked or two-column.

modules.name: Data Table
modules.description: A data grid with sortable columns and row selection, built on the Table contract.

modules.name: Avatar Group
modules.description: An overlapping identity stack with an overflow count.

modules.name: Stat
modules.description: A labeled metric with a trend delta and optional supporting content.

modules.name: List
modules.description: A vertical item list with leading and trailing slots, secondary text, and a dense mode.

modules.name: Sparkline
modules.description: A tiny inline trend chart in line, area, or bar form with an accessible summary.

modules.name: Calendar
modules.description: A month grid for picking a single date with bounds and disabled days.

modules.name: Result
modules.description: A full-area outcome state for success, error, and HTTP results with a standard icon and actions.

modules.name: Activity Feed
modules.description: Chronological list of actor-plus-action events with avatars or icons and timestamps, optionally grouped under day headings.

modules.name: Area Chart
modules.description: Line chart with a filled area under each series, an adjustable fill opacity, and a stacked mode for part-to-whole trends.

modules.name: Bar Chart
modules.description: Grouped SVG bar chart with vertical or horizontal bars, optional value labels, a legend, and a built-in accessible data table.

modules.name: Calendar Heatmap
modules.description: GitHub-style year calendar heatmap with weeks-by-weekday cells, a 0–4 level color scale, and month labels.

modules.name: Chart Container
modules.description: Accessible SVG frame for hand-rolled charts with an aria-label summary, a toggleable screen-reader data table, and reusable axis, grid, and legend primitives.

modules.name: Comment Thread
modules.description: Nested comment list with author avatars, timestamps, caller-wired reply buttons, and collapsible reply threads.

modules.name: Diff Viewer
modules.description: Line-based diff view with added/removed/context coloring, a +/- gutter, and old/new line numbers.

modules.name: Funnel Chart
modules.description: SVG funnel of stages whose widths follow their values, with stage-to-stage conversion percentages.

modules.name: Gantt Chart
modules.description: A read-only SVG Gantt chart that plots task bars on a day grid with a today marker.

modules.name: Gauge Chart
modules.description: Semicircle SVG gauge with min/max scale, threshold zones, and a centered value label.

modules.name: Heatmap
modules.description: Matrix heatmap that maps values to a color scale with row/column labels and cell tooltips.

modules.name: JSON Viewer
modules.description: Collapsible JSON tree with type-colored values, key-count summaries, and optional hover copy-path buttons.

modules.name: Kanban Board
modules.description: A column-based board where cards move between workflow stages with full keyboard support.

modules.name: Line Chart
modules.description: Multi-series SVG line chart with axis ticks, focusable points, simple or custom tooltips, a legend, and a built-in accessible data table.

modules.name: Log Viewer
modules.description: Scrollable monospace log pane with severity coloring, a follow/auto-scroll toggle, and optional search highlighting.

modules.name: Markdown View
modules.description: Renders a safe markdown subset — headings, emphasis, links, lists, code, and quotes — as teal-styled elements with no raw HTML.

modules.name: Org Chart
modules.description: A hierarchy of person nodes rendered as connected boxes, with collapsible subtrees.

modules.name: Pie Chart
modules.description: SVG pie and donut chart with keyboard-focusable segments, percentage labels, a legend, and a built-in accessible data table.

modules.name: QR Code
modules.description: Dependency-free SVG QR code renderer with a hand-rolled byte-mode encoder (error-correction level L).

modules.name: Radar Chart
modules.description: SVG radar (spider) chart that overlays multi-series polygons across a shared set of axes.

modules.name: Scatter Chart
modules.description: Hand-rolled SVG scatter plot with x/y axes, multi-series dots, and optional size encoding.

modules.name: Tree Grid
modules.description: A data table whose rows form an expandable tree, following the WAI-ARIA treegrid pattern.

modules.name: Stack
modules.description: A flex primitive that stacks children along one axis with consistent spacing and alignment.

modules.name: Grid
modules.description: A grid primitive with fixed columns or responsive auto-fit tracks.

modules.name: Resizable
modules.description: Pointer- and keyboard-resizable panes with percentage sizing and double-click reset.

modules.name: Aspect Ratio
modules.description: Keeps media or content at a consistent width-to-height ratio.

modules.name: AppShell
modules.description: An application frame that places header, sidebar, main and footer regions into named grid areas.

modules.name: Box
modules.description: The lowest-level layout primitive: a polymorphic box with spacing props, leaving surfaces and colors to className.

modules.name: Center
modules.description: Centers children horizontally and vertically inside their box, with an inline option for flow content.

modules.name: Columns
modules.description: An equal-width grid column layout that keeps row alignment and collapses to fewer columns on narrow screens.

modules.name: Container
modules.description: Centers content in a max-width column with responsive horizontal padding and fixed size steps.

modules.name: Flex
modules.description: A flex container primitive with direction, gap, alignment and distribution props; defaults to a horizontal row.

modules.name: Masonry
modules.description: A CSS-columns masonry layout where unequal-height items pack tightly down each column without row gaps.

modules.name: ScrollShadow
modules.description: A scroll container that fades the top and bottom edges to signal that more content exists in that direction.

modules.name: Section
modules.description: A semantic page section with vertical rhythm spacing and an optional centered container wrap.

modules.name: StickyHeader
modules.description: A header that sticks to the top of its scrolling container and gains a shadow once it is stuck.

modules.name: Visually Hidden
modules.description: Hides content visually while keeping it available to assistive technology.

modules.name: Copy Button
modules.description: A button that copies a value to the clipboard and confirms with an icon swap and live feedback.

modules.name: Theme Toggle
modules.description: An icon button that toggles the dark class on the document root and reports its state.

modules.name: Carousel
modules.description: A scroll-snap carousel with previous and next controls, dot indicators, and arrow-key support.

modules.name: Collapse
modules.description: Animates a region's height to show or hide content, marking it hidden and inert while closed.

modules.name: Countdown Timer
modules.description: Counts down to a target date with a default HH:MM:SS display or a custom render prop, firing onComplete at zero.

modules.name: Focus Trap
modules.description: Keeps Tab and Shift+Tab focus cycling within a container and restores focus when deactivated.

modules.name: Highlight Text
modules.description: Wraps every case-insensitive match of a query in a styled mark element.

modules.name: Infinite Scroll
modules.description: Loads the next batch of content automatically when a sentinel scrolls into view via IntersectionObserver.

modules.name: Lazy Image
modules.description: Defers an image request until it nears the viewport, showing a placeholder and fading the image in on load.

modules.name: Marquee
modules.description: Scrolls content horizontally in a seamless CSS-animation loop with pause-on-hover and reduced-motion support.

modules.name: Number Ticker
modules.description: Animates a number toward its target with a requestAnimationFrame count-up and a pluggable formatter.

modules.name: Portal
modules.description: Renders children into a different DOM container, escaping overflow and stacking-context traps.

modules.name: Presence
modules.description: Keeps children mounted through their exit transition before unmounting them.

modules.name: Reveal
modules.description: Fades and slides children in when they scroll into the viewport via IntersectionObserver.

modules.name: Time Ago
modules.description: Renders a self-updating relative timestamp like "5 minutes ago" with the absolute time on hover.

modules.name: Truncated Text
modules.description: Clamps text to one or more lines with a show more/less toggle and a tooltip for the full text.

modules.name: Virtual List
modules.description: Renders only the visible slice of a large fixed-height list, keeping thousands of rows scrolling smoothly.
